gloss_en: Shifra — the biblical midwife (Exod. 1:15; identified with Yocheved, Sotah 11b), whose name denotes beautifying (meshaperet) the newborn; in LM II:71 the aspect linking birth (holada), the fetal sac/placenta (shafir ve-shilya), beauty of form (yefeh to'ar/Yosef), and the flow of supernal pleasantness
